content: KAWILA KƗGA LA NYAN KAT JISAS KWUNATNDƗ
Jisas nduwimba lɨga ngaga yandɨ. Ngaga yandɨ maa tat ndɨnai mbukna vak wuka la nɨmba ndɨna kwupmba yalaa yisolaa lɨndi ndu lagwa.
Tɨga lɨga kawia kɨga la nyan yalaa Jisasna mangɨndamba kwali kwali sɨlaa Jisas kat wandɨ. Njambwi nyan wun kat kwunapmak wameyan alɨpsɨga kwunakiyamɨn.
Wandɨ maa Jisas ndɨna mbangɨmba taamba taagalaa wandɨ. Mɨn kat tamba kwunakowun. Apma vat yetɨ mɨla waa wandɨ maa kawia kɨga lɨnda vat wan kawia kasendɨ.

Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ. Awup mɨla. Mɨn kat kwunakwa vak nat nɨmba kat mɨn ke mbuka. God kat kwunatɨga nyan kat mɨna yiga mɨna mbangɨ sɨmogwi mɨla. Mɨna mbangɨ vɨlaa God Moses waa vapmba kwanda kwanda vatnyalaa God kat kwigiyandɨ. Kwindeya vak vɨlaa mɨna mbangɨ kwo lɨnda vak kat vɨgiyandi waa wandɨ Jisas.
SOLDIANA NJAMBWI NYANA NJƗVWA KWUTA NYAN KAT JISAS KWUNATNDƗ
Jisas Kapaneam walɨnja ngepma yiga wuleindɨ maa njambwi soldia yalaa Jisas kat wandɨ.
Jambwi nyan wuna njɨvwa kwuta nyan yelogwen kat tɨgandɨ. Ndɨna ava kiyandɨ, njambɨmba kwandɨ. Nɨma kangɨt yilɨndɨ, tɨgandɨ waa Jisas kat wandɨ.
Wandɨ maa Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ. Yiga kwunakiyowun wandɨ.
Wan nyan Jisas kat wandɨ. Wun apma nyan ana wun. Wuna ngay manda kat yaigamɨn. Kai wowun. Kumba lɨga nyaangɨt mɨna wamɨn maa wuna njɨvwa kwutɨga nyan kwo lɨgiyandɨ.

Wuna njambwi soldia wun kat vɨga lɨgandɨ. Ndɨna kwundi wuka lɨgowun. Wuno nat nɨmba kat vɨga lɨga nyaangɨt mbutɨga nyan wun. Wuna kwupmba lɨga soldia kat ay waweyan yigiyandi. Yagwa waweyan yaigandi. Wuna njɨvwa kwutɨga nyan kat njɨvwa agwut waweyan ndɨ kwukiyandɨ waa wandɨ njambwi soldia.

Jisas wutaa ngɨpaliga ndalaa wandɨ. Ndɨna maawupmba yelavɨka lɨnda vak vla ana Isrelmba lɨga nɨmbana maawut yelavɨka lɨgandi. Ndi kat aywaa kwulatndɨ. Ndɨna maawut apma vat tɨgandɨ. Yelogwen kat kwa nɨmba kat kwunatuwa vak ndɨ vɨga lɨgandɨ.
Yigumba awuk ngwula. Nyinangwut wuleigiyaa wan kava. Wuleilaa Judana njambwi nɨmba Ebraham, Aisak, Jekopnogwinala kɨta vak kɨga kɨta yelangɨmba yetɨgiyandi.
Judana nat nɨma sakwat nɨmba ndi ana wuleigiyandi. Nat nɨmba wuleigiyandi. Ndi wuleilapman nɨmba kavle kava yilaa nglaga nɨmbi ngliaka lɨgiyandi waa Jisas ndi kat wandɨ.

Ndi kat walaa njambwi soldia kat wandɨ. Mɨna ngay ay mɨla. Wagalama vat tɨgiyandɨ waa wandɨ maa yilaa ndɨna njɨvwa kwuta nyan kwo lɨnda vat vɨndɨ. Vɨlaa yelavɨtndɨ. Jisas waa njɨmblamba ndɨ kwo lɨndɨ waa yelavɨtndɨ.
PITANA NASAKWAT YELOGWEN KAT TƗLƗ, JISAS LƗ KAT VƗLAA KWUNATNDƗ
Jisas Pitana ngay wuleilaa ndɨna tangwana nyɨme yelogwen kat tɨlɨ, vɨndɨ. Lɨla mbangɨ kangan walɨndɨ, njambɨmba kwalɨ.
Jisas lɨla taamba kwutndɨ maa lɨla mbangɨ kangan yelogwen vɨtɨnda vak ngɨlɨndɨ, laataa kɨgɨnda kwutɨ Jisas kat.
JISAS NƗMA SAKWAT NDU LAGWA KAT KWUNATNDƗ

Nglaambu kavle waagan tavila la nɨmba kat kwutaa Jisas ta kavat kiyandi, ngwuk kavle waagan ndi kat kwagalalaa ay ngwula waga ndi kat kwunatndɨ. Yelogwen kat ta nɨma sakwat ndu taagwa yandi, vɨlaa ndino ndi kat kwunatndɨ.
Ndi kat kwo ana kwunatndɨ. Tamba la profet Aisaia pɨlɨwuthnda nyaangɨt vla kwunatndɨ. Tamba Jisas kat pɨlɨwutndɨ. Yelogwen kat tɨna vak ndɨna lak klalaa kwunatndɨ waa tamba pɨlɨwutndɨ.
JISASNA KWUPMBA YIVAT WA NƗMBA
Nɨma sakwat nɨmba yalaa yisolaa lɨndi vɨlaa Jisas tamatndɨ. Ngi kat tɨga Jisas njaambɨt kulaa wandɨ maa ngusamba kaga nat naangat valɨgendi.
Kawindi mala Moses kwiya nyaangɨt sɨmogwi lɨga nyan yalaa Jisas kat vɨlaa wandɨ. Sɨmogwi lɨga nyan yimeya kava wuno mɨna kwupmba yigiyowun waa wandɨ maa

Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ. Kwapɨmba yetɨlɨga waala sɨndu kwalɨnda waangu ngi lɨga. Waavi sɨndu kwalɨnja ngay ngilɨga. Wun Godna vak ndinyangu kat sɨmogwi lɨga nyan wun sɨndu kwaweya kava kai waa wandɨ Jisas.
Ndɨna kwupmba yetɨ lɨga nyan laataa Jisas kat wandɨ. Njambwi nyan. Wuna nyaek tamba wundumbu yindɨ. Ndɨ kat yiga waangu vala nguvat wowun. Ngɨni yalaa mɨna kwupmba yetɨgiyowun waa wandɨ maa
Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ. Ke yiga ndɨna mala. Wuna kwupmba yavak kat kai walɨga nɨmba ndi waangu vala waangumba ngugandi. Mɨn wuna kwupmba yagwa mɨla waa wandɨ Jisas.
JISAS WANDƗ, MWUK KIYAK WANDƗ
Jisas njaambɨt ndɨna mbaapma nɨmbonala kulaa yindɨ.
Yilɨndi maa nɨma mwutolo kwutndɨ, pali laatndɨ Nɨma pali laataa ndina njaambɨt wuleindɨ. Jisas sɨndu kwandɨ.
Ndɨnagwi kɨta vat ya nɨmba ndɨ kat sɨvɨlulaa wandi. Njambwi nyan. Nɨna njaambɨt tamba kambruka tɨgandɨ. Nɨn ngu kɨgiyanɨn waa wandi.

Jisas laataa ndi kat wandɨ. Ngwuk manda kat vaatɨgangwuk. Njambwi nyanat tuwa vat ana ngwuk nɨmamba yelavɨtɨgangwuk waa walaa mwukagwi pali kat wandɨ, kiyak wandɨ. Mwuk kiyak wandɨ, pali ndɨno kiyak wandɨ. Ngu yuvut tapman tɨndɨ.
Ndɨna nyan manda nyana. Mwuk pali ndɨnai waa vapmba wutɨnda waa wandi.
KAVLE WAAGAN TAVILA LA VƗLƗLƗK PALƗ KAT JISAS KWUNATNDƗ

Njaambɨpmba yiga Gadara walɨnja ngepma kawindi anguveli naangamba. Kawindi maa kiya nɨmbana waangumba yetɨ lɨga mbɨt nyan laataa Jisas la kavat yambɨt. Kavle waagan tavila la mbɨt nyan. Kao mbundɨ nyan mbɨt. Nat nɨmba mbɨk kat vaaka lɨndi. Tɨlɨmba kavamba ana yi ya yetɨlɨindi.
Jisas kat vɨlaa mbɨt kɨselaa wambɨt. Mɨn Godna nyan mɨn. An kat angamak yigiyamɨn. An kat kavle vat yivat yamɨn? An kat kwulapmeya njɨmbla na ndɨ waa kɨselaa wambɨt.
Nɨma sakwat mbak wan kavamba kɨga yetɨndi.
Mbɨk kat tavila la waagan Jisas kat wagalambɨt. An kat savɨlɨvat wameyan savɨlɨlɨmɨn maa mbapmba wuleilaa yigiyaa. Wovuna? waa wagalambɨt.
Wagalambɨt maa Jisas kwowa ay mbɨla wandɨ. Mbɨk kat kwagalalaa yiga mbapmba wuleimbɨk maa wan mbak vaaka pɨlɨga ndaiga satnat yindi. Yilaa wan mbak aywaa ngu kɨgiyatndi.
Wan mbak kat vɨga la nyangu ngepmat pɨlɨga yiga ngepmamba la nɨmba kat nayaangɨt mbutndi. Kavle waagan ndu nyan kat kwagalalaa mbapmba wuleilaa pɨlɨnja vak kat yiga mbutndi.
Ngepmamba la nɨmba wutaa Jisas la kavat yindi ndɨ kat vɨvat. Ndɨ kat yiga vɨlaa wandi. Nɨna kɨpma kwagalalaa mɨn ay mɨla wandi.
